column1: # test_chinese_v1.0.bin and test_english_v1.0.bin are the frozen results of one Fresh Start: ground state -> one learning pass over one corpus.
# They are read-only. The version number in the name rises only when a Fresh Start is triggered; the old pair is then archived, never edited.
# Commands (HOME pointed at a throwaway directory so nothing touches ~/.ptolemy):
#   build/zh/ptolemy_zh -q -c clean/test_chinese_v1.0.bin -l corpora/text/zh_v1.txt     # Unicode code-point alphabet (Horner base 0x110001 mod 2^61-1)
#   build/en/ptolemy_en -q -c clean/test_english_v1.0.bin -l corpora/text/en_v1.txt     # ASCII-95 alphabet (Horner base 95), -DALPHABET_ASCII95
# Counts as the engine reported them: zh vocab 5981, word_count 5902011, A_edges 2064975.  en vocab 24940, word_count 5858570, A_edges 9373394.
# Not examined: no speak/lookup was run on either file (instruction: ingest both, do not look at results).
